name: JSHookMCP
description: TypeScript MCP server for JavaScript analysis, browser automation, network capture, JS hooking, and cross-platform native FFI.
capabilities: network capture and protocol analysis (HTTP/2, gRPC, protobuf, msgpack)
debugging: breakpoints, stepping, V8 inspector protocol
JavaScript hooking, deobfuscation, and source maps
cross-platform native FFI: Win32, Mach, POSIX syscall
